title: The p-value for z = 2.3
caption: The shaded tail beyond 2.3 has area 0.0107; a two-sided test doubles it: p = 0.0214.
alt: Standard normal curve with the upper tail beyond z = 2.3 shaded, area 0.0107, to be doubled for the two-sided p-value.
description: Under H₀ the statistic is standard normal.
